description:
keying.rs (recursion_supplied_positions doc, ~785-795) records a measurement and cites fz-kdt.213 as its owner; no such ticket exists on the board. The recorded fact: across the fixtures, of the executables added (attributed to the function they key) 36 land on a function that gains a distinct published return and 91 do not, dominated by List.reduce_cont/3 (21), List.reduce_while_cont/3 (18), Range.reduce_while_cont/6 (9) and List.reduce_while_step/3 (6) minting empty_list()/list(tau) ascent rungs across the cont<->step cycle. The comment proposes the strong component and the reverse call edge, because the rebuild belongs to the callee's position.

fz-xxd.10 deletes FactKey::CallGraphComponent (nothing reads it after R3), so the comment's proposed input no longer exists and the comment is rewritten there.

Investigate on develop after fz-xxd.10: re-measure the 36/91 split; paper first (shrunk program, predicted rungs) before any design.
title: The cont<->step reduce recursion mints ascent rungs that no distinct return needs
